name: Nari's lightsaber
description: Nari's lightsaber was owned by the Jedi Nari during the Great Jedi Purge. In 9 BBY, while being hunted by the Inquisitors, Nari pleaded the former Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi for his help and presented the lightsaber to him. Kenobi urged Nari to abandon the lightsaber and to live a normal life, much to Nari's dismay.
